adapter: declarative bounded retry scenarios in an unprivileged candidate child

coverage.area: package identity, exports, dependency, and scripts
success values, attempt numbering, and retry budgets
callback order, policy, context, and callback failures
backoff, delay caps, randomization, and elapsed-time limits
falsy results, callback defaults, and infinite option values

excluded_upstream_checks: TypeScript inference assertions beyond declaration entry and public signatures
multi-second wall-clock tolerances and exact stack formatting
commented AVA examples that are not collected upstream
live network requests and benchmark tooling
determinism: Named callback policies, controlled timer tokens, fixed random sequences, and broad bounded signal cancellation replace executable callback payloads and long elapsed-time assertions.
